summary: Sunrise Communications AG filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting (AGM) held on 7 May 2026. All agenda items were approved, including the dividend distribution of CHF 3.42 per Class A share and CHF 0.34 per Class B share, re-election of directors, and ratification of auditors. The AGM is a routine corporate governance event with no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report on an ordinary shareholders' meeting, and no extraordinary transaction or activist campaign is present.
